canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON; recursively sorted keys; separators comma and colon; ensure_ascii=false; trailing newline excluded

data.fingerprint_method: SHA-256 incremental ORDER BY symbol,date; symbol UTF-8 + NUL + date ASCII + NUL + big-endian IEEE-754 open/high/low/close doubles + signed 64-bit integer volume
data.fingerprint_pending_reason: specification locked before execution; fingerprint recorded fresh at execution time

scope_decision: reuses tom_daily_differential and tom_volatility_diagnostic unchanged from Calendar Turn-of-Month v1; only the event mask (weekday instead of month-position) and the test direction (negative/underperformance, matching French 1980's actual claim) differ; single locked day (Monday), no five-way weekday scan

day_of_week_event.definition: DOW(t) = 1 if session t's calendar weekday is Monday

differential.definition: Delta = mean(daily_log_return | DOW=1) - mean(daily_log_return | DOW=0), excluding the first synthetic zero-return padding entry of each asset's history

bootstrap.p_value_convention: one-sided; fraction of resamples with resampled_differential <= observed, plus add-one correction

gates.reproducibility: byte-identical differential/p-value artifact on an independent rerun against the same fingerprinted data

diagnostics.volatility_comparison: per-asset standard deviation of daily log returns on Monday vs. non-Monday days, disclosed, non-gating

multiplicity.parameter_grid: none in this run; one locked weekday (Monday) sourced from literature, not fit to this data

scope_exclusions.no_costs: out of scope for this no-trade characterization run
scope_exclusions.no_forward_horizon: contemporaneous realized-return partition, not an event-then-forward-return design
scope_exclusions.no_five_way_weekday_scan: only Monday is tested; a full weekday scan would introduce a new multiple-comparisons dimension deliberately avoided here
scope_exclusions.no_book_level_or_executable_expression: any tradeable expression remains a separate, later, separately locked protocol
